APPROVED450KW PANTO-UP HARDWARE REFERENCE, issue49, 2026-10-18. ABB2019/2021 PantoUP brochure9AKK107991A4055 RevB https://library.e.abb.com/public/a1c552cfb24c4b6ca6fc3ddef737c884/9AKK107991A4055-Rev%20B_Panto_UP_Brochure_01-2021.pdf ; ABB2021 HVC portfolio9AKK107991A6983 RevC pp13-16; ABB Terra1842023 PEP ABBG-00284-V01.01-EN p6 bulk-material ANALOGUE, not HVC BOM. PSI2023 vehicle LCI Table70 for24year/10bus service reference. Retain original bus-up architecture: three150kW/1340kg cabinets plus500kg pole/interface, total4520kg before separate installed feeder cables. The historical7.533333333*600kg multiplier already reproduces4520kg; the error is its old Level2 material mix plus additional complete charging stand, not proof of an incorrect cabinet count. Do not substitute1650kg PantoDown pole or add a stationary battery. Replace historical charger/stand path by dedicated mass-budget reference. One shared7inchHMI+PLC2kg is included within totalcabinet mass, not added on top; source HMI is in mastercabinet, one-set architecture assumed. Each six-face2030x1170x770mm cabinet has2mm/7700kg/m3 ferritic430 enclosure as GEOMETRY ASSUMPTION. Material430 reference83%unalloyedsteel+17%metalCr,1kWh+4MJ/kg melt/finish is an explicit supply/process proxy, not measured430 metallurgy or proof of zero traceNi. Remaining cabinet mass uses full Terra184 bulk-class fractions per395kg as a deliberately explicit engineering analogue, including8kgunknown/395kg left unassigned, not invented as zero metal. Topology, transformer core grade, semiconductors, cooling and actual HVC tin/critical-metal contents remain unvalidated. In particular8kgTin/395kg is the published TerraEPD category, not an HVC measurement; test0.1-1x this transferred tin factor and0.5-2x other non-enclosure material factors while retaining fixed cabinet mass and reporting residual coverage. No extra genericpowerPCB on top of all bulk ingredients. Internal heat sinks/air cooling are included in transferred categories; cooling system type/service fluids and semiconductor die recipe remain gaps. Reference500kg interface explicitly assumed to include45kg contactdome,12kgPUcontrolbox and443kg support, since source nested mass boundaries are not fully specified; alternative add45+12kg to500kg in sensitivity. Dome public materials glassfiber/Cucontactrails/AlCP-PErails represented20kgGFRP+20kgCu+5kgAl engineering partition; controlbox6kgsteel+2kgCu+1kgAl+3kgprotection/comms-board allowance; pole443kgordinarycarbonsteel. These are not manufacturerBOMs. The moving roof pantograph belongs to the bus: no mass/recipe was recovered, so retain it as an explicit vehicle-side COVERAGE GAP, not an invented second offboardpantograph. External feeder reference10m: two parallel185mm2Cu conductors perDCpole plus70mm2protectiveearth;20kgPE cableinsulation/jackets and1kgcontrolcable proxy.10m is design assumption within manufacturer distance envelope, not a measured site. Ampacity/voltage drop/installation/field lengths need engineeringverification; no road/commoncivilinfrastructure added. Bulk inputs100%finalretention reference plus genericmetalworking/assembly1kWh/kg; no fabricatedmeasuredscrapyield. Keep original24yearlife,10bussharing and four perkmstationdoses; public RLT/warranty does not establish actual lifetime. Replacement sensitivity1-2.4cabinetsets in24years; support remainsone. Manufacturer94-96%charger efficiency is not the total battery/grid efficiency; leave existing vehicle purchased energy/losses untouched and add no duplicate operating/standby energy. End-of-life, maintenance, roofpantograph and unresolvedcomposition are recorded gaps; no recoverycredits or primary-secondaryclaim.
